record_under_review.evidence_span: The lead author’s ISCA presentation post describes Vistara as Meta’s end-to-end CXL solution spanning ASIC design, firmware, OS-level memory tiering, and hyperscale rollout. It reports deployment across disaggregated ML inference, big-data processing, databases, distributed caches, and software build/test pipelines; the post claims up to 25% fewer servers for disaggregated inference, reuse of decommissioned DIMMs as CXL memory, and tiering overhead below 0.5% in the described production-minded design.
record_under_review.hardware_or_process_assumptions: Hyperscale datacenter CXL deployment with custom silicon and OS memory tiering; exact server fleet, CXL generation, workload methodology, tail-latency distributions, and comparison design require the full paper.
record_under_review.limits: The evidence is a lead-author/company social post, not a full paper or independently audited deployment report. Claims require paper-level verification of fleet scale, baselines, workload methodology, tail latency, overhead definitions, cost, and carbon accounting.
record_under_review.method_or_artifact: An end-to-end CXL deployment path combining custom ASIC design, firmware, OS memory-management mechanisms, production workload integration, and operational rollout.
